target_customer: Software engineers and teams who already pay for Claude Code or Codex and want to run many agents in parallel
problem: Coding agents tie up a laptop and one local environment. Running many in parallel needs isolated machines with the full dev environment, which is slow to set up by hand.
business_model: Per seat SaaS tiers ($19 to $249 per user per month) with included box-hours and usage overage at $0.40 per box-hour; users bring their own agent subscription
product_category: Cloud development environments for AI coding agents

founders.name: Nick Bushak
founders.background_notes: YC page says he founded Gem and led engineering teams at Facebook. Education not stated on the pages opened.

founders.name: Drew Regitsky
founders.background_notes: Principal engineer and first employee at Gem per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs per-agent cloud VMs with snapshots of filesystem and memory, sleep and wake, and integrations with Slack, Linear and agent CLIs. Standard infrastructure engineering for two experienced engineers, with no research risk.

defensibility.rationale: The product wraps third party agents on rented compute and the site says it does not resell tokens. Environment snapshots and team integrations give some stickiness, but larger platforms can offer the same.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known. The model labs and code platforms ship cloud agent runners of their own, so the wedge is exposed. No source found describing a specific response.

market_need_then: Launch coverage (Show HN, Product Hunt in June 2026) frames running agents locally as the pain. Demand evidence beyond launch upvotes was not found.

branding.domain_note: boxes.dev, a .dev domain with the exact brand name

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and technical; site states it is independent of Anthropic and OpenAI

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Hacker News and Product Hunt (109 upvotes and 24 comments reported by an aggregator); no merch or fan community found

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that shares words with other developer tools. Only launch-day coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Very early company in the Fall 2026 batch, so no outcome exists yet. Strengths are a repeat founder pair with an earlier YC company and a tailwind from heavy use of coding agents. The risk is that model labs and code platforms ship their own cloud agent environments, which would commoditize the wedge.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed round and a Sep 2026 founding date, seen only on that aggregator and unverified, so no round is recorded. Other sources give a Product Hunt launch on 2026-06-04, which conflicts with the Dealroom date. Searches for dated competitors returned launch coverage only and named no competitors, so the list is empty. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: the $125K seed (no date or investors) is recorded from Dealroom, a single database.
